messages:
Lina (PM): Heads-up: Q2 planning for Hosted API features. We need a clear slice plan for chat stability, embeddings latency, and rerank throughput so we can land OKRs. Goal: reduce embed p95 and increase rerank steady-state QPS.
Ben (Eng): I sketched three candidate slices: (A) Embeddings perf (async batching + hot-key cache), (B) Chat streaming hardening, (C) Rerank batching + memory safety. Each slice should be independently deployable.
Maya (ML): Couple of constraints: quantized emb models help latency but may shift similarity scores. We need a small goldset per customer to track drift. Also rerank top-k work needs pruning/early-exit support to stay in memory.
Kei (Solutions): From customers: Searchly wants embed latency <120ms p95 for single requests; DocuNote wants rerank throughput ~8k QPS for 512-token docs. Both asked for migration playbooks and SDK examples.
Sam (Data): I'll produce an eval bundle: 500 representative queries for embeddings, and a 2k query rerank bench. Will add daily regression diffs. Question: what alert thresholds should we wire?
Lina (PM): Proposal for gates: embeddings: p95 <=120ms on benchmark + cosine drop <=1.2% vs baseline. Rerank: 95th latency per-request <=200ms under target QPS AND end-to-end MRR delta <=1.5%. Canary acceptance from at least one customer required.
Ben (Eng): Rough implementation timeline:
- Sprint 1 (2w): async batching + routing flags for embeddings, basic canary plumbing
- Sprint 2 (2w): replay/caching for prefixes, streaming fixes for chat
- Sprint 3 (2w): rerank batching and memory limits + rollout automation
We can reduce to 2 sprints if we scope out telemetry and non-blocking dashboard polish.
Maya (ML): I will run a quantize vs float comparison on our small goldset and post differences. If cosine delta >1% we'll need to consider mixed strategy: quantize for inference but keep float fallback for quality-critical requests.
Kei (Solutions): For canaries I can recruit Searchly as primary; they already run on our hosted model and are comfortable with flags. Will draft customer-runbook + signoff checklist.
infra-bot: Test instances provisioned for rerank spike tests: a10g-sim-3x, scheduled Tue 04:00-08:00 UTC.
Sam (Data): Dashboards I'll ship: per-route latency p50/p95, CPU/GPU mem under load, quality diff timeline. ETA Monday.
Lina (PM): Decision points by Friday sync: commit to 3-sprint plan OR compress to 2, pick primary canary (Searchly vs DocuNote), finalize gating thresholds. Also we need to draft OKR language: reduce embed latency p95 by 30% and increase rerank throughput 2x for short-doc workloads.
Ben (Eng): Risks: bursty workloads could blow batching queues and increase tail latency. Need to add circuit-breaker (request queue cap) and fallback path to single-request mode. Also need routing change to allow per-customer model pinning.
Maya (ML): On regression detection: recommend blocking if cosine drop >1.5% on goldset OR rerank MRR drop >2% for two consecutive daily runs. Lina ok?
Lina (PM): That's acceptable. We'll codify stricter thresholds in the launch doc.
Kei (Solutions): I'll prepare migration notes and a quickstart snippet for the SDK: how to enable async embed and how to opt-in for canary.
Ben (Eng): Action items: I will put the sprint breakdown and the minimal spike testcases in an RFC tonight. Also will add the queue cap + fallback plan.
Sam (Data): I'll finalize eval bundle and wire nightly runs.
Maya (ML): I'll publish quantization results by Wednesday and include suggested fallback logic.
infra-bot: Canary rollout window proposed: Thu 09:00-13:00 UTC.
Lina (PM): Thanks team. Please react with :ok_hand: if you agree to the plan and timelines. We'll reconvene Friday 10am to lock OKRs and ship dates.
Ben (Eng): :ok_hand:
Maya (ML): :ok_hand:
Kei (Solutions): :ok_hand:
Sam (Data): :ok_hand:
